item.title: Go FSs Everywhere: Treat Side Effects as Dependencies
item.author: technicalblog123@arran4.com (Arran Ubels)
item.description: If your Go code calls os.Create, os.Stat, exec.LookPath, or net.Dial directly from business logic, your tests are forced to touch real side effects more often than necessary. The pattern in this article is simple: Define small interfaces for side effects. Inject real implementations in production. Inject fakes or in-memory versions in tests. This is why I encourage myfs.Stat("file.txt") (or whatever your project names it) over direct os.Stat("file.txt") in your core application code.
